name: Uitly
tagline: Uitly.pro is an all-in-one online utilities platform built to simplify everyday digital tasks
description: Uitly.pro is an all-in-one online utilities platform built to simplify everyday digital tasks. It provides a growing collection of free web-based tools including QR code generators, barcode generators and scanners, URL shorteners, Base64 encoders, image utilities, converters, calculators, and productivity tools. Uitly focuses on speed, simplicity, and user-friendly design, helping developers, marketers, businesses, students, and creators complete tasks quickly without installing software.
